desktopSettings.approvalBody.en: A request is waiting for your decision.
desktopSettings.approvalBody.zh-CN: 有一项请求正等待你的决定。

desktopSettings.closeToTray.zh-CN: 关闭窗口时最小化到托盘

desktopSettings.closeToTrayHint.en: Keep Paperclip running in the background when its window closes. Use the tray menu to quit.
desktopSettings.closeToTrayHint.zh-CN: 关闭窗口后让 Paperclip 在后台继续运行；请从托盘菜单退出。

desktopSettings.description.en: Choose how the installed desktop app behaves in the background.
desktopSettings.description.zh-CN: 设置已安装桌面应用在后台的运行方式。

desktopSettings.notificationsHint.en: Ask the system to show notifications for approval requests and failed or timed-out runs while the app is in the background.
desktopSettings.notificationsHint.zh-CN: 应用在后台时，请求系统为审批请求、失败或超时的运行显示通知。

desktopSettings.notificationsUnavailable.en: Native notifications are unavailable on this device.
desktopSettings.notificationsUnavailable.zh-CN: 此设备无法使用系统通知。

desktopSettings.quitHint.en: Stop the local Paperclip service and close the app. Running work may continue remotely.
desktopSettings.quitHint.zh-CN: 停止本地 Paperclip 服务并关闭应用。正在运行的工作可能仍会在远端继续。

desktopSettings.saveFailed.zh-CN: 无法保存桌面应用偏好设置。

desktopSettings.trayUnavailable.en: The system tray is unavailable on this device.
desktopSettings.trayUnavailable.zh-CN: 此设备无法使用系统托盘。

desktopSettings.unavailable.zh-CN: 桌面应用偏好设置不可用。
